question.text: A CIV scheme (Co-Investment Vehicle) under SEBI (AIF) Regulations is available to investors of which category/categories of AIFs?

answer.text: Category I and Category II AIFs only

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Chapter 7.1.3: CIV schemes are permitted under SEBI (AIF) Regulations for Cat I and Cat II AIFs — they allow a parallel investment opportunity to specific investors of the original scheme in unlisted securities of an investee company where the AIF is also investing. **The Trap:** Option B is false. Option C over-generalises. Option D restricts to a sub-category. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-A explicitly tests CIV; XIX-C adds the documentation-structuring angle (PMS route vs CIV scheme route). **Manager's Pro-Tip:** When drafting a CIV scheme, mirror economic terms (fee, carry, LP rights) of the parent scheme. Divergence here invites accusations of preferential treatment and regulatory scrutiny under SEBI's circular on differential rights.
